_readme: Gear page data. To turn on an affiliate link, paste it into that item's "affiliate" field; the page then uses it instead of "link" and marks it sponsored. tier: $ under 70, $$ 70-150, $$$ over 150. Prices are rough as of Nov 2026: check before quoting.
